title: Compose
description:
Implement a `compose` function that combines functions right-to-left. `compose(f, g)(x)` is equivalent to `f(g(x))`.

**Example:**
```js
const double = x => x * 2;
const addOne = x => x + 1;
compose(double, addOne)(3) // double(addOne(3)) = 8
```
ai_context: The key insight is right-to-left execution — learners who implement with `reduce` instead of `reduceRight` get `pipe` instead of `compose`. When no functions are passed, `reduceRight` with an initial value correctly returns the initial value, making the edge case safe.
